No malicious content was found in the queried files, but behavioral logs confirm C2 communication and suspicious rundll32 execution. Response actions include blocking C2 IPs, credential reset, and endpoint eradication.

title: Suspicious DNS Tunneling via High-Entropy TXT Queries
logsource:
  category: dns_query
  product: windows
detection:
  selection:
    QueryType: 'TXT'
    QueryName|re: '^[a-f0-9]{16,}\.[a-z]{3,}\.exfil-c2\.example\.com$'
  condition: selection
level: critical

rule CobaltStrike_Metasploit_Shellcode {
    meta:
        description = "Detects common Cobalt Strike shellcode patterns"
        author = "SOC_Team"
        last_modified = "2026-04-10"
    strings:
        $a = { FF E0 } // JMP ESP
        $b = { 64 A1 30 00 00 00 } // FS:[0x30] (PEB access)
        $c = "Crypt32" wide ascii
    condition:
        all of them
}
